# AMC Spotlight Frame

<!-- Generated by tools/build-templates.mjs from template.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Region Template** for Universal Theme · direction: motion · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

A region frame where a pointer spotlight and a glowing border follow the mouse, and a faint grid lights up under the beam in the header only.

**Use it for:** Dashboard regions a user works in: a Classic or Interactive Report, a Chart, a Form or a KPI Cards region on a landing page.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, through the Builder):** App Builder > your app > Shared Components >
  Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_tpl_spotlight_frame.sql` (Component Export). It creates the
  template in Universal Theme and its Static Application File(s) in `amc-templates/`.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/region-templates/amc-spotlight-frame.apx` and
  `dist/apexlang/shared-components/static-files/amc-templates/` into the app, add the entries from
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx` to `shared-components/static-files.apx`, then run the apexlang gates.

## Use

On any region, set **Appearance > Template** to **AMC Spotlight Frame**. In APEXlang: `appearance { template: @amc-spotlight-frame }`.

Region template with a pointer spotlight. Title and icon come from the region; Help, Edit, Change, Copy, Delete and Create buttons sit in the header, Previous, Close and Next in the footer. The border lights up where the mouse is, a soft light follows it across the frame, and a faint grid appears inside the light in the header. Keyboard focus moves the light to the focused field. Without JavaScript, on touch screens and under reduced motion the light rests in the top start corner and does not move. Template options change the light color to success or danger, widen the light, swap the header grid for dots, or remove the body padding for edge-to-edge reports. In forced-colors mode the frame becomes a plain system border.

## Template options

| Option | Class | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Success light | `amc-TSpotlightFrame--success` | Border glow and light use the success palette color. |
| Danger light | `amc-TSpotlightFrame--danger` | Border glow and light use the danger and warning palette colors, for escalations and exceptions. |
| Wide light | `amc-TSpotlightFrame--wide` | A larger, softer spotlight for big regions such as full-width reports and charts. |
| Dot pattern | `amc-TSpotlightFrame--dots` | Replaces the header grid with a dot pattern that appears inside the light. |
| No body padding | `amc-TSpotlightFrame--noPadding` | Removes side padding so reports and grids run edge to edge. |
